mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 63 degrees. Tonight will see an overnight low of 53 degrees, and we have no rain expected.

For our city updates, the Verona Police Department is accepting applications for their upcoming Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program covering everything from O W I investigations to K-9 demonstrations. Additionally, general election notices for November have been posted for the community.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at various local venues. Tomorrow, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes over Main Street, and coming up on September 14th, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 15th.

Regarding local reports, on September 10th, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress. A 19-year-old suspect was taken into custody after a firearm was discharged, though no injuries were reported.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open, but please note they will be closing in just 23 minutes, so you have just enough time to grab a scoop.
